summary: Single-reference revision: preserve the existing gold/parchment editorial mockup as-is, remove the two .sec-label eyebrows with a rebalanced eyebrow-row (flex-end) and increased .note-headline top margin, and soften the .screen banded wash and .hero-glow radial toward the file's own body::before precedent and ui-ux-pro-max's 0.08-0.12 opacity / 30-50px blur ambient-glow convention for premium dark-mode mobile UI.
